payload.prompt: If you take on my slayer assignments out past the ditch, the beasts might leave behind a special key to open pirate chests hidden deep in the Wilderness. What is this key called?
Braving the Wilderness carries real risks, so I always make sure the payoff is worth your time. How many Slayer points do I hand out as a base reward for finishing one of my tasks?
Be careful out there in the wilderness! A Teleblock can really ruin an escape! If a player doesn't have Protect from Magic active when it lands, how many minutes does the full block last?
Be careful pulling strange levers! The one tucked behind the Ardougne tavern sends an unwary traveler straight to the Deserted Keep. At exactly what Wilderness level will you arrive?
Mandro runs a handy resource haven out past the lava, though he asks for a little toll at the gate. Without any Wilderness Diary perks, how many coins does entry cost?
Ancient Magicks can be a real lifesaver when you need to make a getaway. Which combat spell keeps a pursuer completely frozen in place for a solid 20 seconds?
